name: Sacral / Spinal Chordoma
definition: Rare malignant notochordal tumor most often involving the sacrum or clivus, characterized by locally aggressive growth and high recurrence risk.

typical: Neurological or sphincter symptoms when advanced

investigations.principle: MRI defines soft-tissue and neural extent; CT characterizes bone destruction; biopsy planning must be oncologic.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Unplanned biopsy or excision can compromise definitive oncologic surgery.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi/Majja framework may be documented only as a parallel layer.

patientEducation.summary: Rare malignant notochordal tumor most often involving the sacrum or clivus, characterized by locally aggressive growth and high recurrence risk.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
